Bridal care

Ahead of scheduled events such as wedding photography, the ceremony and dress fittings, we address facial contours, body contours and overall well-being together.

Wedding Timeline

Facial and body contour care planned around your photo shoot and wedding

With wedding dates set, the aim is a plan that considers well-being, puffiness, facial balance and the dress silhouette together, rather than pushing for drastic changes.

  1. 01Review your schedule

    We set priorities around your photo shoot and wedding dates.

  2. 02Facial balance

    We first review concerns about facial asymmetry, puffiness and the jawline.

  3. 03Body contours

    We discuss concerns about the upper arms, thighs and abdomen in relation to your dress silhouette.

  4. 04Maintain your well-being

    We also work on sleep, digestion and stress patterns.
